description: Worked examples of what a kind of business uses: which capabilities, in what order, what one unit of it costs to run, and what the builder still owns. Optional reading: a described business is composed without one (trustycap_compose_kit). For "make this production ready", the backend install contract is the default. An example is a starting point, never a finished product: the brand, the customer, the pricing and the business model belong to the builder. The tool's name keeps a legacy identifier.
name: trustycap_list_launch_kits
title: List example businesses
